# Sud0ops

> Sud0ops is a technology and DevOps consultancy based in Cape Town, South Africa, working with small businesses, growing teams and non-profits in South Africa and the UK. It designs, builds and supports the systems a business runs on: automation, integrations, reporting and cloud infrastructure.

Most businesses do not have a technology problem; they have an operations problem. Sud0ops starts with how the work actually gets done, then implements and supports the tools that improve it, working alongside the client's team rather than handing over a report.

## Capabilities

- Workflow automation and tool integration
- Dashboards, reporting and internal assistants
- Process, efficiency and SaaS reviews
- DevOps and platform engineering: CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring and security
- Cloud architecture and cost management, AWS first

Engagements follow four stages: discover, build, adopt, support.

## Leadership

Sud0ops was founded by Alex-Jay Beukes, a DevOps and platform engineer with a background in AWS platform leadership. He led DevOps for the AWS Equity Equivalent Investment Programme at Skywalk Innovations, standardising CI/CD and monitoring across its client portfolio, and served as technical consultant to helperhub, a live payroll and HR platform, where he set the migration strategy off a legacy monolith. He is currently responsible for cloud governance and platform reliability at Rhino Africa. He also advises ProVision Alliance, a youth-focused NPO, on a pro bono basis. His work centres on zero-downtime migrations, delivery standards and cloud cost control.

Profile: https://sud0ops.com/about-founder · LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/alex-jay-beukes · Credly: https://www.credly.com/users/alex-jay-beukes

Contact: alex@sud0ops.com

## Pages

- [Home](https://sud0ops.com/): the four problems Sud0ops fixes (workflow automation, tool integration, AI assistants, operational dashboards), the discover, build, adopt, support loop, house rules and recent work.
- [Services](https://sud0ops.com/services): service lines and the platforms Sud0ops works with.
- [Consulting](https://sud0ops.com/consulting): three entry points: an investigative consultation, a fix for a known problem, or a SaaS review.
- [Clients](https://sud0ops.com/clients): selected work for helperhub (technical consultancy and implementation), Bashies (Shopify store and SEO), Happy Shisha (custom social events platform) and ProVision Alliance (pro bono technical advice for a youth NPO).
- [About the founder](https://sud0ops.com/about-founder): Alex-Jay's story, career, selected work, certifications and toolkit.
- [Blog](https://sud0ops.com/blog.md): posts on automation, DevOps, cloud and AI, as a markdown index. Every post is available as markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown` to its URL, or add `.md` to it.
